title: Add an LRU cache with deterministic expiry
prompt: Implement LruTtlCache in src/cache.js and export it from src/index.js. Constructor accepts `{ maxEntries = 100, ttlMs = 0, now = Date.now }`. Validate maxEntries as a positive integer, ttlMs as a finite non-negative number, and now as a function. `set(key, value)` refreshes recency and evicts least-recently-used entries until within capacity. `get` and `has` lazily remove expired entries; `get` refreshes recency only for a live entry. ttlMs 0 means no expiration. `delete` and `clear` return whether anything was removed. Pass `npm test`.
